title: Transient diquat inclusion and carboxylate-rim binding to carboxymethyl-α-cyclodextrin: a molecular dynamics study
authors: Jing Chen; Xu Wu; Yongjian Huang; Wei Fu
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子动力学模拟环糊精与敌草快的主客体结合，属于小分子-环糊精体系，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Rotaxane-based supramolecular scavengers have shown promise for diquat detoxification, but the relative contributions of cavity inclusion and interactions at the macrocycle rim remain unclear. We used all-atom molecular dynamics simulations in explicit water to examine diquat binding to carboxymethyl-α-cyclodextrin (CM-α-CD) and the behaviour of CM-α-CD on a poly(ethylene glycol) axle. Five systems were simulated: host-guest mixtures containing a neutral host (pH 3 model) or a hexaanionic host (pH 10 model), an explicitly constructed inclusion complex, and two-macrocycle pseudopolyrotaxanes initiated from pre-threaded or random configurations. The total production sampling was approximately 4.5 μs. A relaxed threaded geometry was obtained, with the diquat centroid 0.03 nm from the cavity axis and 9 of its 14 heavy atoms within the defined cavity cylinder. The guest left this geometry within the first 50 ps sampling interval and subsequently remained associated mainly with the carboxylate rim. During 1.2 μs of unbiased sampling of the hexaanionic host-guest system, only 5 of 802 guest-frame pairs contained a guest atom within the cavity cylinder, and all of these events occurred near a portal. Rim contacts were more frequent: each guest formed an average of 3.8-4.4 host heavy-atom contacts per frame, with 12.8-14.0% of guest heavy atoms in contact with the host. These interactions were substantially reduced for the neutral host. Sodium ions remained predominantly solvent-separated from the carboxylates. In the pseudopolyrotaxane simulations, pre-threaded rings satisfied the threading criterion in 1.6-8.4% of frames, and no spontaneous threading was observed from random configurations during 1 μs. Under the simulated conditions, CM-α-CD therefore bound diquat primarily through dynamic rim interactions rather than persistent cavity inclusion.
abstract_zh: 基于轮烷的超分子清除剂在敌草快解毒方面展现出潜力，但腔体包合与大环边缘相互作用的相对贡献仍不明确。我们使用全原子分子动力学模拟在显式水环境中考察了敌草快与羧甲基-α-环糊精（CM-α-CD）的结合，以及CM-α-CD在聚乙二醇轴上的行为。模拟了五个系统：包含中性主体（pH 3模型）或六阴离子主体（pH 10模型）的主客体混合物、一个显式构建的包合物，以及从预穿线或随机构型起始的双大环假聚轮烷。总生产采样时间约为4.5微秒。获得了一个松弛的穿线几何结构，其中敌草快质心距腔轴0.03纳米，其14个重原子中有9个位于定义的腔体圆柱内。客体在采样间隔的前50皮秒内离开该几何结构，随后主要与羧酸盐边缘保持关联。在六阴离子主客体系统的1.2微秒无偏采样期间，802个客体-框架对中仅有5个包含客体原子位于腔体圆柱内，且所有这些事件均发生在孔口附近。边缘接触更为频繁：每个客体每帧平均与主体形成3.8-4.4个重原子接触，其中12.8-14.0%的客体重原子与主体接触。对于中性主体，这些相互作用显著减少。钠离子主要保持与羧酸盐的溶剂分离状态。在假聚轮烷模拟中，预穿线环在1.6-8.4%的框架中满足穿线标准，且在1微秒内未观察到从随机构型的自发穿线。因此，在模拟条件下，CM-α-CD主要通过动态边缘相互作用而非持久腔体包合来结合敌草快。
